notice: Original fiction. The depot, Rushly, the Lakelight Festival and every character are invented. Real places are named only as settings; no real business, person, event or service is depicted.
premise: Margo's independent courier depot by Union Station is one bad season from closing: Rushly, an app courier, is taking the city's offices. If the depot wins the city's Lakelight Festival delivery contract it survives. The rookie, Margo's last hire, earns the neighbourhoods' trust while Rosa runs dispatch, a rival rider called Dev changes sides and the depot's leaked bid is traced back to Rushly.

ROSA.role: Dispatcher; runs the radio, dry and loyal

MARGO.role: Owner of the depot since 1979, proud and broke

SAL.role: Cheese stall at St Lawrence Market; the depot's oldest client

TOMAS.role: Glassblower with a studio in the Distillery District

PRIYA.role: Permits clerk at City Hall who runs the festival tender

INES.role: Art handler by the Grange; moves the festival art

WEN.role: Bike shop and coffee bar in Kensington Market

BEA.role: Florist on Queen East by the Don

OTIS.role: Ferry dock clerk who knows the lake's moods

NADIA.role: Runs a shipping office at East Bayfront

KAI.role: Festival crew lead at the tower plaza

LEE.role: Runs the newsstands in the Line 1 and 94 stations

JOY.role: Ward's Island cottager, Margo's old friend

DEV.role: Rushly rider; a rival who changes sides

CLEO.role: Cafe and gallery on Queen in Parkdale, Marco's cousin

FINN.role: Repair shop near Roncesvalles and Howard Park

OWEN.role: Keeps the lodge at the south end of High Park

DINA.role: Books the acts at a Danforth music hall

MEI.role: Bea's sister; shop at Leslie and Queen

chapters.name: First shift
chapters.synopsis: The rookie's first runs for Margo's depot. Sal, Ines and Tomas try the new courier.

chapters.name: Neighbourhoods
chapters.synopsis: Rushly took the downtown offices, so the depot wins the neighbourhoods: Juno, Wen, Marco and Bea. Dev of Rushly appears.

chapters.name: The festival bid
chapters.synopsis: The city tenders the Lakelight Festival deliveries. Margo bids; a copy of her bid turns up under Rushly's name.

chapters.name: Crossing the city
chapters.synopsis: Margo's van dies on the viaduct, the bank gives the depot until the fall and Dev quietly helps.

chapters.name: Waterfront
chapters.synopsis: The festival barge docks at Bayfront; a lake storm strands Auntie Joy's mail.

chapters.name: Arts and audiences
chapters.synopsis: Ines moves the festival art. A crate goes missing in Rushly's yard until Dev tips Rosa off.

chapters.name: Evening dispatch
chapters.synopsis: Night shifts. Vance offers to buy the depot, Margo refuses and he leans on her bank.

chapters.name: Festival week
chapters.synopsis: The last week before Lakelight: the streets jam and everything moves by TTC. Dev quits Rushly and joins the depot.

chapters.name: Lakelight
chapters.synopsis: Opening night, the council vote on the last night, the leak exposed and the depot saved.
